rawUserRequest: 继续执行交互式安装与校准向导计划的 Task Outcome 扩展工单；实现 Project Profile 控制的、隐私安全的 PR Outcome Summary 展示，并完成本工单的测试、PR、合并、ai-close-work-item 与分支清理。

declaredIntent.summary: Expose a compact, privacy-safe Task Outcome Summary for pull-request reviewers only when the Project Profile explicitly approves that presentation.

title: Integrate sanitized Task Outcome Summary into pull request presentation
outOfScope: GitHub API calls, PR creation, merge, or branch cleanup
Full Task Outcome Markdown or machine-truth JSON changes
Project Profile schema changes and multilingual rendering

sources.reason: Task Outcome extension: PR presentation must expose only a Project-Profile-approved sanitized summary.
Project Profile is the approval boundary for user-visible reporting policy.
Machine-truth section names and evidence-derived fields are the source for sanitization.
Existing full Markdown renderer is deliberately kept separate from PR presentation.

riskAssessment.reason: PR output is an external presentation boundary and must not leak evidence details or imply unsupported claims.

executionDecision.reason: Bounded implementation: generate a sanitized PR fragment only when the Project Profile explicitly enables it.

preReviewWarnings: Review that PR output is opt-in, privacy-safe, evidence-derived, and does not include scores, paths, digests, or full report sections.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A deterministic renderer produces a PR-safe Outcome Summary from machine-truth JSON.
Rendering is disabled unless the Project Profile explicitly approves PR reporting.
Only approved allowlisted fields are rendered; evidence paths, digests, forced-stop details, and unsupported quantification are excluded.
Empty and warning/residual-risk states remain visible without claiming success.
Focused tests cover opt-in policy, sanitization, deterministic output, and CLI behavior.
guidelines: PR presentation is a derived view and must not mutate machine truth.
Do not expose evidence paths, digests, secrets, scores, or unsupported quantitative claims.
The PR renderer must remain separate from archive and lifecycle mutation logic.

intent.problem: Task Outcome is now generated and archived, but a pull request needs a compact reviewer-facing summary without copying the full report or exposing sensitive evidence.
constraints: PR output must be opt-in through Project Profile policy
Machine truth remains JSON and the full Markdown report remains available
No external platform mutation is part of this Work Item
intent.rationale: A small pure renderer creates a stable presentation boundary that can be used by PR tooling while preserving evidence ownership and privacy.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized completion of every serial Work Item; this WI must register its production/test association and Make entrypoint with existing guards.
